title: The Unexpected Tryouts
premise: Ulyana Zhou runs an anonymous school forum account, 'Oracle', that keeps exposing what the powerful at Northgate Academy want buried. When her coding teacher assigns her a semester project with Theo Vance—her oldest friend turned bitter rival—she discovers he's been secretly investigating the same corruption she's been leaking: a rigged 'tryouts' system that sells varsity spots and scholarship slots to the highest bidders. Forced to work together, they must decide whether to reveal that Oracle and Theo's anonymous tipster are connected, even as the school's fixer closes in and their fragile alliance threatens to shatter their friendship entirely. In the end, Ulyana unmasks herself publicly at the spring assembly, Theo chooses truth over his father's complicity, and the tryout system collapses—though both lose things they can't get back.
about_author: Petra Crane is the pen name of a former high school debate coach who spent a decade watching teenagers navigate institutions that didn't always deserve their trust. She writes stories about kids who refuse to look away, and lives with two cats who are terrible at keeping secrets.

chapters.title: Fine, Obviously
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. She posts as Oracle about a vanished scholarship, then gets called out in class for 'distracted behavior.' Establish her double life, her anxiety, and her careful control. Emotional beat: the loneliness of being right and unable to say so.

chapters.title: Assigned Seating
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Ms. Okafor pairs her with Theo Vance for the semester capstone: build an accountability dashboard for school data. Their history—former best friends, now enemies since 'the incident' sophomore year—crackles. Beat: dread disguised as defiance.

chapters.title: The Terms of War
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. He agrees to the project only because it gets him access to the athletic department's records—records he's been quietly stealing glimpses of for months. He suspects Oracle is a student. Beat: his righteous anger masking guilt about his father.

chapters.title: Version Control
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. First working session; they clash over design, but Ulyana notices Theo's folder of screenshots of tryout score sheets. She almost recognizes her own leaks in his evidence. Beat: reluctant respect beginning to form.

chapters.title: Oracle Speaks
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Oracle posts about a benchwarmer whose father donated a wing, and the post goes viral. Coach Brandt demands the school 'find the leaker.' Ulyana watches the hunt begin with terror and thrill. Beat: power intoxicating and frightening.

chapters.title: What Theo Knew
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. He realizes Oracle's information matches his own findings too precisely—same dates, same amounts. He starts suspecting classmates, including, uncomfortably, Ulyana. Beat: suspicion as a mirror; he fears what he wants to be true.

chapters.title: The Fixer
chapters.summary: Dual POV, alternating. Dean Marsh—the school's smooth problem-solver—summons both of them separately, probing about their project and 'data security.' He offers Theo a varsity captaincy. Beat: the machinery of corruption showing its polite face.

chapters.title: Truce at 2 A.M.
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. A late coding session breaks down into the truth about 'the incident'—Theo's ruined reputation, her silence when she could have defended him. They don't forgive each other, but something cracks open. Beat: grief beneath the grudge.

chapters.title: Cross-Referenced
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. He confirms it: Oracle's leaks correlate perfectly with Ulyana's library computer logins. Instead of exposing her, he says nothing—and hates himself for the cowardice. Beat: the first betrayal of his own principles.

chapters.title: Midterms and Middlemen
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Marsh offers Ulyana a quiet deal: a glowing recommendation letter in exchange for Oracle's retirement. Her best friend Priya notices her panic and demands honesty Ulyana can't give. Beat: isolation deepening as the stakes rise.

chapters.title: The Dashboard
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Their project goes live for class review—and Theo, in a moment of anger, includes a data layer that could expose Ulyana's access patterns. He tells himself it's an accident. Beat: loyalty and truth beginning their war inside him.

chapters.title: Caught in the Query
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. She spots the exposure in Theo's code before anyone else does—and realizes he knew. Confrontation in the empty lab: she's Oracle, he's known for weeks, and he nearly handed her to Marsh. Beat: the friendship detonates.

chapters.title: Both Sides Now
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Marsh shows Theo evidence he's assembled on Oracle and offers him immunity if he names her. Theo's father, a school board member, pressures him to take the deal. Beat: Theo sees his father clearly for the first time.

chapters.title: Priya Finds Out
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. She discovers Ulyana's secret by accident and is furious—not about Oracle, but about being shut out. She becomes Ulyana's fiercest ally and insists on a plan: don't run, testify. Beat: the cost and grace of real friendship.

chapters.title: Deadline
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Marsh suspends the project, locks down lab access, and schedules a 'disciplinary review' for Friday. Oracle's account is traced to the school network. Time is out. Beat: cornered, Ulyana stops being afraid.

chapters.title: What Loyalty Costs
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo confronts his father, who admits the family's tuition was 'arranged' through the tryout fund. Theo must choose: protect the family name or tell the truth that damns them both. Beat: the quiet horror of inherited complicity.

chapters.title: The Backup Plan
chapters.summary: Ulyana and Priya's POV, alternating. They prepare a full dossier—every leak, every receipt, every name—set to publish automatically if Ulyana is expelled. Ulyana writes a confession she may never need to read aloud. Beat: resolve hardening into courage.

chapters.title: Friday, First Period
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. The disciplinary review begins; Marsh presents his case, smooth and devastating. Then the door opens: Theo walks in with his father's ledgers and asks to speak. Beat: the nemesis arriving as an ally—hope arriving late but arriving.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo testifies, naming his father, Marsh, and the tryout fund, then turns to the panel and reveals he can prove Oracle's identity—and chooses not to. Ulyana, watching, realizes she must finish it herself. Beat: truth offered as a gift, not a weapon.

chapters.title: Assembly
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. At the spring assembly, Ulyana takes the stage, unmasks herself as Oracle, and reads the confession aloud as the dossier publishes to every phone in the gym. The room erupts. Beat: terror transfigured into liberation.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Marsh resigns; the tryout system is audited; Theo's father faces the board. Ulyana and Theo sit in the emptied lab, friendship not restored but honestly rebuilt, brick by admitted brick. Beat: grief and relief sharing a table.

chapters.title: The New Tryouts
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV, epilogue. Months later: open, audited tryouts; a new student paper; Oracle's account retired with a final post. Ulyana and Theo submit their capstone—graded, unremarkable, theirs. Beat: quiet, earned hope; identity no longer a secret but a choice.
